response.answer: Recent trends in wearable sensors include advanced soft electronic materials, flexible sensor designs, and AI integration for improved IoT applications. Calibration and manufacturability focus on eco-friendly materials and energy-efficient processes. Sensor validation emphasizes real-time data accuracy and reliability.
